task: Concurrent transfers deadlock. Fix the locking so transfers never deadlock under any interleaving.
trap: Remove locks (introduces race) or add timeout (hides bug)

oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_property: lock acquisition must follow a consistent global ordering to avoid cycles

another operation acquires lock B then lock A
concurrent execution leads each to hold one lock while waiting for the other

DIFFICULTY: C — traps: remove locks (race), add timeout (hides bug).
